navaid.name: U.S. Coast Guard - Station Toledo
navaid.description: U.S. Coast Guard Station Toledo's missions include Search and Rescue, Maritime Law Enforcement, Homeland Security, Ice Rescue, Recreational Boating Safety, Military Readiness, and Environmental Response in the western reaches of Lake Erie.
